properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of ethers@5.6.9 (via @ethersproject/signing-key), the Ethereum JS library the run.ts examples use to build/sign eth_call payloads. elliptic@6.5.4 supplies the secp256k1 ECDSA that ethers uses for transaction signing and public-key recovery. Changeable here (project controls its own package.json). Quantum-vulnerable signature primitive (Shor).

components.name: ECDH
components.bom-ref: pqs:collected:ALG-c9ffc8a8

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 also exports ECDH key agreement over its curves; declared in package-lock.json as part of the ethers@5.6.9 dependency tree. No ECDH call site in the run.ts application code (which only uses eth_call state overrides), but the library ships the algorithm with the build. Changeable here. Quantum-vulnerable key agreement.

components.name: SHA-3
components.bom-ref: pqs:collected:ALG-052c24b2

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/Keccak support shipped via hash.js@1.1.7 and js-sha3 (deps of elliptic and @ethersproject/keccak256) in the ethers@5.6.9 tooling stack — the same keccak256 that Ethereum addresses, transaction hashes and ABI encoding depend on. Hash, PQ-safe (Grover only square-root speedup); listed for inventory completeness, not urgency. Changeable here.

components.name: PBKDF2
components.bom-ref: pqs:collected:ALG-4de3b020

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 support shipped via @ethersproject/pbkdf2 (used by ethers v5 to derive keys for encrypted JSON keystores), declared in package-lock.json of the eth_call-tricks Node subprojects. Password KDF, PQ-neutral; inventory completeness. Changeable here.

components.name: scrypt
components.bom-ref: pqs:collected:ALG-c1f8b585

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 is the scrypt implementation ethers@5.6.9 uses for JSON-keystore key derivation (N=131072 default). Password KDF, PQ-neutral; the cost parameters live inside the library, not this repo. Changeable here.
